business_problem: Chongcheng Technology needed a digital platform that could standardize agricultural operations across fragmented fields and connect sensors, equipment, imagery, and lab data into one decision system. Traditional agriculture had very low digital penetration, and the company also needed secure cloud infrastructure for large, distributed agricultural data and customer-facing applications.
solution_summary: Chongcheng Technology built its CCtech industrial-internet PaaS platform and downstream agricultural SaaS applications on Alibaba Cloud to support smart orchards and other digital-farming scenarios. The platform combines an industrial IoT middle layer, big-data layer, AI compute layer, expert knowledge base, and user center so sensor feeds, farm machinery, image-recognition outputs, and partner-lab models can be collected and analyzed in one place. That data is then used to drive intelligent sensing, warning, decision-making, and visualized results for orchard monitoring, planting management, product traceability, and agricultural operations. To make the platform production ready, Chongcheng uses Alibaba Cloud databases, load balancing, NAT gateway, elastic public IP, and security services such as DSC, WAF, and Content Security. This gave the company a cloud base for smart-orchard deployments, traceability systems, and broader intelligent-agriculture SaaS delivery across mountain and hill farming environments.

solution_components.role: Distributes traffic for Chongcheng's cloud applications and field-service endpoints.

solution_components.name: NAT Gateway
solution_components.role: Provides controlled network access for cloud-based agricultural workloads.

solution_components.name: Data Security Center
solution_components.role: Helps secure agricultural and farm-operational data with automated threat detection and governance.

data_flow: Sensor readings, farm-equipment data, image-recognition outputs, and lab-originated base models enter the CCtech PaaS platform, where the data is aggregated, analyzed, and converted into visualized recommendations. Those outputs feed smart-orchard, traceability, aquaculture, and other agricultural SaaS applications used by growers and operators.
business_outcome: Chongcheng created a production cloud platform for digital agriculture and smart-orchard operations instead of treating each farm deployment as a one-off project. The same cloud foundation now supports sensor collection, AI analysis, traceability, and security controls, while downstream customers have seen material labor and feed-cost improvement in digital farming scenarios.
